plugins.name: VibraVid
plugins.description: Backend on the server; web client on devices. Search and download movies, series, anime, and albums (HLS/DASH/MP4). Published image from AstraeLabs. Use only with content you have rights to.

plugins.name: Stremio
plugins.description: Stremio Web plus streaming server in one container. Discover and play movies and series through addons. Published image from tsaridas/stremio-docker. Use only with content you have rights to.

plugins.name: WebSSH
plugins.description: Browser SSH client (password, key, TOTP). Connect to hosts on the Hub server network. Published image from austozi/webssh (huashengdun/webssh).

plugins.name: Apache Guacamole
plugins.description: Clientless remote desktop gateway (RDP, VNC, SSH) in the browser. Published image from flcontainers/guacamole (Apache Guacamole web + guacd + PostgreSQL). Default login guacadmin / guacadmin — change it immediately.
